# Device Extension API

The API for adding support for custom drives and I/O devices by authoring device profiles and registering them with the profile registry (for example via `LXMASTER_REGISTER_DEVICE`).  [More...](#detailed-description)

## Detailed Description

The API for adding support for custom drives and I/O devices by authoring device profiles and registering them with the profile registry (for example via `LXMASTER_REGISTER_DEVICE`). 

Most applications never need this tier.
